summary: Iteration 2 covered the new additive features (Auto-debate, blind peer review 'Council Standings', Perplexity-style Synthesize, PDF export, per-turn voice replay) plus regressions. Backend: 14/14 pytest tests pass (added test_tts_ok, test_review_requires_two_speakers, test_synthesize_without_openrouter_key, test_synthesize_bad_chairman, test_export_pdf, test_export_not_found). Frontend: full Playwright sweep on /session/<id> — all dock buttons render (synthesize-btn, auto-debate-btn, rounds-select, open-floor-btn, round-table-btn, review-btn, notes-btn, conclude-btn, export-btn, mute-toggle, mic-btn, send-btn, message-input); rounds-select cycles 2r→3r→4r→1r→2r; Synthesize dialog opens with 5/5 chairman-<id> and question defaults to session title; Peer review with no turns surfaces the 'two members must speak' toast; Auto-debate without an OpenRouter key surfaces graceful error, stop-debate-btn appeared transiently and reverted to auto-debate-btn; Conclude picker still lists 5/5 draft-with-<id> (no regression); Export PDF opens a new tab hitting /api/sessions/{id}/export which returns 200 application/pdf (1911 bytes, starts %PDF-1.4); mute-toggle flips 'voices on'↔'voices off'; message-input focuses and accepts typing; leave-btn present. No crashes anywhere; no unexpected console errors beyond the intended 400s for missing OpenRouter key.

issues: Radix DialogContent a11y warning still applies to Conclude Drafter dialog (already reported in iteration 1). Chairman picker and Council Standings dialogs correctly include DialogDescription.

action_items: Optional: Home 'Convene a council' button has no data-testid (test had to fall back to text selector 'Convene a council'). Add data-testid="convene-btn" to the primary CTA on Home for stable e2e selectors.
Optional a11y: add DialogDescription to the 'Assign the conclusion drafter' dialog (Radix warning).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /tts hides all failure modes under a generic 500 'Voice generation failed'; consider surfacing the underlying reason (rate limit vs bad voice) in logs at ERROR level (currently WARNING).

Room.jsx runSynthesize sets thinking=chairmanId but on catch resets to null — good. However when synthesis fails BEFORE any answers are produced, no partial answers are appended (correct); confirmed graceful.

Frontend uses window.open(exportUrl(id), '_blank') — most browsers open PDF inline which works, but Playwright's 'expect_page' -> wait_for_load_state('domcontentloaded') can time out because PDF response has no DOM. Not a bug, but tests should verify via page.request.get instead of relying on popup load state.
reportlab imports are done lazily inside export_pdf — good for cold-start cost, but consider moving to module-level to fail fast at import time.
server.py:121 HTTP-Referer hardcoded preview URL (same note carried from iteration 1).
test_credentials: None (no auth). OpenRouter key intentionally absent — negative-path tests. EMERGENT_LLM_KEY present and TTS verified working end-to-end.
seed_data_creation: One TEST session created via API (TEST_new_features_flow) for the frontend flow; deleted at end. Pytest module fixture also creates/deletes TEST_new_features_session and TEST_should_we_ship_agents.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 2 fully covers new endpoints /api/sessions/{id}/review, /api/sessions/{id}/synthesize, /api/tts, /api/sessions/{id}/export and their UI counterparts. To exercise live model text (round-table, synthesize success path, review with content, auto-debate), set an OpenRouter key via POST /api/settings {"openrouter_key":"..."}. Home CTA lacks data-testid — see action_items. Direct navigation to /session/<id> is a reliable shortcut when scripting.
